scope: Original 24 matched saved DS24 baseline/policy fits; c0 and fitted_c. All numerical regressions are descriptive of saved postfit conditional CFO residuals. No new detector, IQ, association, geometry or position fits.
limits: Satellite assignments and family counts are model labels, not independently established identities.
Same-label agreement can coexist with changed membership and nuisance estimates.
The c controls are matched within each saved group; half/full memberships differ.
Residual correlations are conditional and dependent; they do not identify hardware or TLE causality.
Full-endpoint band information is a frozen full-fit local diagnostic, not separate half-fit uncertainty or calibrated confidence.
Offset/drift coefficients describe a prior-coupled calibration solution; single-band offset/drift modes cannot be interpreted as independently identified hardware quantities.
No fitted c localization advantage follows from a smaller frequency residual.
No change to production files or scientific fixtures.

Seed feasible-candidate counts are inherited nomination metadata, not current posterior ambiguity; some recovered final tracks still carry feasible_candidates=0 and compatible=False in the historical seed.
